steps.text: Talulah changed.
The first time I met her, the feeling she gave me was just like that of Her Majesty, Theresa.
But, Her Majesty has always been tragic, burdened... and she knew more about the secrets of this land.
Talulah is different. She is wrathful, but just calm enough. Still, a zealous anger burns within her.
Though they were different in many small ways, they had the same kind of strength. Or, maybe people like them are similar in many ways regardless of their strength.
This anger gave rise to Reunion, which attracted countless followers.
But soon... she changed.
Our daily work has turned into incitement. Provocation. Destruction.
This is no longer a revolution for the masses of Infected—
—but rather the same kind of over-engineered, conspiratorial war that we have seen in Kazdel, time and time again.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: She hasn't caught up yet.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...If we really run into her head-on, there's going to be trouble.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You shouldn't use your Arts on Talulah. This isn't the first time either. We must always be careful of what we see.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Something must have happened to Talulah. We have to tell W.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We've got a lot of heavies suspicious of us thanks to W's little plans. Do you want to make things even worse?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: What exactly did you see?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: The old Talulah was just a rebel. She freed the Infected and gave them an opportunity to fight back.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But now? There's no effort made to curb their base desires. There is only mindless destruction and killing.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: That doesn't prove anything. That's how the other races have always treated the Infected. They're not like Sarkaz.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...You don't understand.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: The behavior by itself isn't a big deal, but I'm talking about the consequences...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Talulah... She's sabotaging Reunion, on purpose.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Why?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Don't you think this situation feels familiar?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: She is an excellent leader who can rally ordinary Infected into battle, and win.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But she's the only one who could dismantle the very tower she built, piece by piece, totally undetected.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I could even say...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Talulah herself is just a slightly fancier brick, something that can be crushed at any time.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Are you saying that...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: It's just like three years ago.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But he... he might've always been like that. He did it all without hesitation... He was just good at hiding it.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Talulah isn't like that. Her change was too sudden.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Her shadow... It's as if there are two shadows, but I see no traces of Arts. It's more like...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: A set of ruins. Ancient and imposing, still full of lingering power.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The nature of your Arts is very special. But your feelings are too vague this time, and I can't base my decisions on vague feelings.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But W needs to know!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Quiet, we've already been noticed.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Anything we do can be used against someone else. You understand this, yes?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Do you think we can survive a second Babel incident?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I'm not sure...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...I know W can't.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I'll go find her. Garcin is dead, so she should be the new leader.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Wait! If Talulah really has her eyes on us already, if you do this—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I can't wait any longer. Don't give me orders, we're still the same rank.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I say that, but this is the first time I've disobeyed your orders.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You shouldn't always overthink things, Hoederer.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: (W should be right ahead. Once I cross this alley...)

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: (Isn't that the base camp? What is she doing?)

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: (Anyway, I need to hurry up...)

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Who are you?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Infected...? What do you want with me?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Watch your tone, devil.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: First, a few mercenary teams defected. Then, enemies started showing up in the city.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Your bunch has made too many mistakes. Did you really think our leader hasn't noticed?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Out of my way. I don't have to listen to your whining.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: You have to answer to Talulah.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...I know. After I report to W, I will then report to Talulah.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: There's no need for that.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: That's not the kind of 'answer' we need.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Tch... Are you serious?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: We got attacked, and the fighting spread over here. Ines, one of the mercenary team leaders, is dead.

steps.name: Determined Reunion Caster
steps.text: You're not going to identify the body?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: ...The fighting was pretty noisy. It's drawing a lot of attention. Blow the whole street, now.

steps.name: Determined Reunion Caster
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Wait a second.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Reunion also needs people... who fight like her until the very end.

steps.name: Determined Reunion Caster
steps.text: ...I understand.

steps.name: Determined Reunion Caster
steps.text: Take care of my family. They're still back in town.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Of course. I promise.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: ...Make his corpse look a bit more... Yeah, just like that.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: W will notice soon... Let's go.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Not letting Hoederer follow... turned out... to be the right call...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Tch.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Turns out... they decorate the streets of Chernobog...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...with birch trees...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Haha.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: It looks... just like that old place... with all the shadows weaving together...
